VAGUE_LINK_TEXT.title: Meaningful Hyperlink Text
VAGUE_LINK_TEXT.description: Hyperlink text shall be meaningful and explain the target or purpose of the link explicitly.

KEY_INFO_ONLY_IN_PDF.title: Accessible Non-HTML Documents
KEY_INFO_ONLY_IN_PDF.description: All essential information provided through downloadable formats like PDF must also be available in accessible HTML format.

NO_LANGUAGE_OPTION.title: Multilingual Accessibility
NO_LANGUAGE_OPTION.description: Government websites catering to diverse linguistic citizens should provide explicit language switching mechanisms.

LOW_CONTRAST.title: Visual Contrast Ratio
LOW_CONTRAST.description: Visual presentation of text and images of text must have a minimum contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

MISSING_ACCESSIBLE_NAME.title: Form and Control Labels
MISSING_ACCESSIBLE_NAME.description: All interactive user interface components must have clearly associated descriptive names and labels.

NEW_WINDOW_UNANNOUNCED.title: New Window Warning
NEW_WINDOW_UNANNOUNCED.description: Users must be warned in advance when a link opens in a new browser window or tab.
